en.advancedScopeDegraded: The workspace service is unavailable; the target degraded to locating a workspace by session.
en.advancedScopeNone: No workspace is available yet: open a session on the left, or have the host list the workspaces.
en.advancedScopeNote: What you pick here is a workspace: a whole-layer clear acts on that workspace’s file (shared by every session in it). The user layer is global and independent of this choice.
en.advReadOnlyNote: This list is read-only: My Prompt is the only write surface, and the two buttons below clear a whole layer.
en.assemblyChangeNotRead: This assembly did NOT read the changed plugin-section text.
en.assemblyChangeRead: This assembly read the changed plugin-section text.
en.assemblyDeliveryUnconfirmed: No system/message event was observed for this step, so delivery into this request is unconfirmed (the projection may have deduplicated it).
en.assemblyDeliveryWaiting: No system/message event has been observed for this step yet.
en.assemblyDisabledNow: The assembly-status notice is off: no new notice will be produced (existing observations are kept).
en.assemblyFirstAssembled: Assembled: the prompt you defined is in this assembly.
en.assemblyFirstEmpty: Not assembled: this plugin's section is empty in this assembly.
en.assemblyIntro: Shown here only: it never enters the model context, costs no tokens and does not change the prompt the model receives. A notice appears once per key node — the first assembly of a new conversation, and the next run after a prompt is saved.
en.assemblyKindChange: Next run after a prompt was saved
en.assemblyKindFirst: First assembly of a new conversation
en.assemblyLimitation: Basis: the assembly layer is the section list this plugin finally returned — a `{prepend: true}` listener registered later may still rewrite it, and the Host may collapse the whole list onto the effective `complete` section after the waterfall; the delivery layer is the system/message this step committed on the surface (append or head replace). Whether the HTTP request was actually sent is not observable from a plugin, and this notice does not claim it.
en.assemblyNoNotice: The notice is on for the selected session, but no key node has been reached yet (the first assembly of a new conversation, or the next run after a prompt is saved).
en.assemblyNoRecord: No assembly has been observed for the selected session yet; the result appears here after the next request.
en.assemblyNoSession: The Advanced tab's workspace selector has no session to name yet: open a session on the left, or have the host list the workspaces.
en.assemblyNoticeOnce: Once per key node only — it does not pile up per step.
en.assemblyTextMatchedNo: the delivered text does not carry the full prompt (variables expanded, or rewritten)
en.assemblyTextMatchedYes: the delivered text carries the full prompt
en.assemblyToastChange: Next run after your prompt change
en.assemblyToastFirst: First assembly of a new conversation
en.assemblyToastRefused: This host declares the shell.overlay slot but refused this plugin's registration (no overlay was registered); the verdicts stay in the summary above and nothing else is affected.
en.assemblyToastSlotMissing: This host never declares the shell.overlay slot, so the proactive toast could not be registered (no overlay was registered); the verdicts stay in the summary above and nothing else is affected.
en.assemblyToastUnavailable: This host does not provide the Toast primitive, so proactive toasts are unavailable (no overlay was registered); the verdicts stay in the summary above and nothing else is affected.
en.assemblyWaitingDelivery: Waiting for this step's delivery event…
en.blockAppendExisting: That name is already in the current assembly, so append would not take effect (two sections may not share a name; the Host skips it as name-already-present). Use Replace instead, or change the name to a new, unregistered one.
en.blockMissingName: The section name cannot be empty (the Host answers missing-name).
en.blockNotPresent: That name is not in the current assembly, so replace / hide would be skipped (the Host records section-not-present). Pick a registered name, or use Append to create a new section.
en.copyFail: Copy failed; select the text manually
en.deletedNotice: Removed the {layer} override; effective from the next turn (next-turn).
en.diffHint: Compared per section: base is what was registered, effective is the result after overrides.
en.downloadFailed: The download failed; copy the JSON below: {reason}
en.editDisabledFrozen: The current scope is frozen; an edit would not take effect
en.emptyBody: This scope assembled 0 sections. That is not an error.
en.error.assemble-failed: The host assembly threw while building the snapshot.
en.error.conflicting-query: reset and legacy cannot be combined: reset clears the whole layer, legacy clears only the legacy overrides.
en.error.duplicate-name: The layer holds a duplicate section name.
en.error.history-not-found: That layer history holds no such record.
en.error.history-unusable: The history file cannot be read or written.
en.error.import-commit-failed: The import could not be committed; some layers may already be replaced.
en.error.import-staging-failed: The import could not be staged; nothing was changed.
en.error.import-verify-failed: The staged import failed its own validation; nothing was changed.
en.error.invalid-diff-selector: A diff selector must be "current" or a history record id.
en.error.invalid-enabled: The switch request needs a boolean "enabled".
en.error.invalid-export: An export document must be a JSON object.
en.error.invalid-export-layer: A layer in the import document is malformed.
en.error.invalid-history-record: That history line is malformed and was skipped.
en.error.invalid-interpolate-flag: The config's "interpolateCustom" must be a boolean; that layer was disabled.
en.error.invalid-json: The request body is not valid JSON.
en.error.invalid-name: The section name contains control characters.
en.error.invalid-order: The order must be a non-negative integer (a target index).
en.error.invalid-override: The "section" field is missing or not an object.
en.error.invalid-region: The download region must be one of default, cn or custom.
en.error.invalid-state: A layer state must be one of inherit, on or off.
en.error.layer-not-writable: The target config file is not a valid config; it is never overwritten.
en.error.missing-export-layer: The import document carries no such layer.
en.error.missing-text: replace and append require a text string.
en.error.not-found: The host has no such route.
en.error.override-not-found: That layer holds no such override to remove.
en.error.preferences-unwritable: The preference file could not be written, so nothing took effect.
en.error.registry-http-error: That address answered, but with an error status, so it is not a usable npm registry.
en.error.registry-invalid: That mirror address is invalid: it must be an http(s) URL with a host, and no credentials, query string or fragment.
en.error.registry-not-npm: That address answered, but not with an npm package document (no dist-tags.latest).
en.error.registry-unavailable: The chosen download source is unavailable. Nothing falls back to the default source: retry later, or pick another download region.
en.error.registry-unreachable: Nothing answered at that mirror address within the timeout (a timeout or a network error); nothing was saved.
en.error.trust-fence-unavailable: The connection service is unavailable, so the trust fence refused the request.
en.error.unexpected-order: replace and hide must not carry an order.
en.error.unexpected-text: A hide override must not carry text.
en.error.unknown-action: The action must be replace, hide, or append.
en.error.unknown-export-schema: The "schema" is not this plugin’s export format.
en.error.unknown-import-mode: The mode must be merge or replace.
en.error.unknown-layer: The layer must be user or workspace.
en.error.unresolvable-variable: A {{…}} reference in this text could never be substituted (unregistered, illegal or malformed), so the save was refused. Delete the reference, use a registered variable, or turn variable substitution off first.
en.error.unsupported-export-version: The import document version is not supported.
en.error.variable-lookup-failed: The current variable table could not be obtained, so this write was refused: there is no way to tell which references would expand.
en.error.workspace-unresolved: The workspace layer needs a resolvable session id.
en.error.write-locked: This write was refused: only this plugin’s own section, prompt-setting:custom-prompt, may be written or deleted.
en.exportPreviewCut: The preview shows the first {n} characters; the download is the complete file.
en.fullFiltered: Filtered by origin: this is a recomposed preview, not the server-side rendered text.
en.histCompareHint: Click any two records to compare them: the first becomes the from side, the second the to side, and the window slides after that. Use the Preview button on a row to read one record on its own.
en.histCorrupt: {n} history lines could not be parsed and were skipped.
en.histDetailPending: Pick a record in the list above: preview what it holds, or use it as the from/to side of a comparison.
en.histDiffCrlf: The two sides use different line endings (compared line by line).
en.histDiffSections: Sections: {total} total ({changed} changed / {added} added / {removed} removed / {same} identical)
en.histDiffTruncated: The difference is long; only the first {n} lines are rendered.
en.histEmpty: This layer has no history yet.
en.histNoSession: The workspace layer needs a resolvable session id to read its history.
en.histNote: Every successful save or removal appends one record (the newest {limit} are kept). The history file is appended line by line, never rewritten for a single read.
en.histPreviewMissing: That record is not on this page: go back to the page that holds it, or reload the list.
en.histPreviewMissingHint: It may also have been dropped by the retention limit.
en.histPreviewPolicy: Preview and rollback concern the "My Prompt" section only: no other section of this layer is touched.
en.histPreviewSnapshot: The whole-layer snapshot of this version ({n} override(s))
en.histPreviewSnapshotEmpty: This record carries no whole-layer snapshot (an older record).
en.histRollbackBody: This restores the "My Prompt" section to the content of #{id} and appends a rollback record, which is what makes this rollback itself a version you can roll back again.
en.histRollbackDone: Rolled back to #{id}: the log and the current value are refreshed, effective from the next assembly.
en.histRollbackForeign: That version also overrode {n} section(s) other than "My Prompt"; the write face does not accept those names, so they are not restored.
en.histRollbackScope: This rollback restores the "My Prompt" section only; every other section of this layer is left as it is.
en.histRowPickHint: Click this row to build a comparison: first row = from, second = to, then it slides
en.histScopeDegraded: The workspace service is unavailable; the scope degraded to locating the history file by session.
en.histScopeGlobal: The user layer is global: every record of the layer is listed here, filtered by no session.
en.histScopeHint: This scope belongs to Version history alone and is independent of the View scope inside My Prompt.
en.histScopeNone: No workspace scope is available yet: open a session on the left, or have the host list the workspaces.
en.histScopeWorkspace: Showing the history file of workspace "{name}" (located by session {session}) — every record of that workspace.
en.importAppliedNotice: Import complete: {written} layer file(s) written, {count} change(s), all recorded in history (origin=import).
en.importConfirmBody: The changes below will be written with the {mode} strategy; a failure at any step leaves the existing configuration untouched.
en.importCounts: added {added} / replaced {replaced} / unchanged {unchanged} / removed {removed} / local kept {kept}
en.importModeMerge: merge: imported wins on a clash, local extras kept
en.importModeReplace: replace: the document is authoritative, local extras removed
en.importNeedText: Paste or choose an export document first.
en.importNoChanges: The document matches the current configuration, so a confirmed import changes no file.
en.importPlanHeading: Preview of the change (nothing written yet)
en.importReplacePreferences: Preferences: all {keys} known setting(s) replace preferences.json as a whole.
en.importReplacePresets: Preset library: {presets} preset(s) and {applied} applied record(s) replace presets.json as a whole.
en.importReplaceWarning: Heads up: this import replaces the settings below as a whole — it does not merge, so what this machine holds today is overwritten by the backup.
en.importTextPlaceholder: Paste the exported JSON here, or choose a file…
en.importUnchangedNotice: The document matches the existing configuration; no file was written.
en.importUnchangedWarning: The existing configuration was not modified (byte-identical).
en.mineDraftElsewhere: You still have unsaved text in "{scope}" ({chars} characters). It did not follow this scope change: it is still there, and going back to that scope continues where you left off.
en.mineDraftKept: The configuration changed elsewhere; the text you have not saved is still in the editor.
en.mineDraftScope: The editor is showing an unsaved draft (belongs to: {scope}).
en.mineFrozenBody: Saving still works and the text is stored in the {layer} config, but this scope is frozen by a complete section: this write never reaches the final prompt, and it does not take effect from the next turn either.
en.mineFrozenHowTo: To make it take effect: switch to an agent preset that does not declare complete (the built-in default preset, for example), or drop the complete declaration from the current preset, and then reload the selected session.
en.mineFrozenUnknownBody: The unscoped assembly is frozen by a complete section, but the selected session has no active agent, so whether it is frozen too cannot be confirmed. The text is still written to the {layer} config; if it is frozen too, it will not take effect.
en.mineFrozenUnknownWarn: Cannot confirm whether the selected session’s assembly is frozen
en.mineFrozenWarn: This scope is frozen: the prompt you write will not take effect
en.mineInterpolateInherit: This layer states nothing: it inherits the user layer.
en.mineInterpolateInheritedOn: This layer states nothing, so it inherits ON. Choose "Off" to override that.
en.mineInterpolateLayerOnly: The switch is saved per selected layer; a workspace layer that states nothing inherits the user layer.
en.mineInterpolateNote: When on, this plugin expands {{...}} in this text during assembly; variables this DSH registers: {list}. ({{cwd}} was retired in DSH 0.2.1-rc.1: if it is not in that list, a literal {{cwd}} stays unexpanded and a save that would arm it is refused as unregistered; the working directory now reaches the model as runtime context.) A reference that is unregistered, misspelled or currently valueless stays literal and never fails the assembly. When off, every {{...}} reaches the model exactly as written.
en.mineInterpolateSaved: Variable substitution is now {state}; effective from the next turn (next-turn).
en.mineInterpolateSetNote: "Inherit" states nothing (the field is removed); "Off" writes false, which is what lets a layer close over an inherited ON.
en.mineInterpolateStateSaved: This layer now states {state}; effective from the next turn (next-turn).
en.mineInterpolateWarn: Note: DSH has no escape syntax. With this on you can no longer write a literal {{...}} here — an unregistered, misspelled or malformed reference can never resolve, so saving one is refused outright. It would not break the session; it would simply stay literal forever.
en.mineInterpolateWorkspaceNeedsSession: The workspace layer needs a selected session; without one the switch cannot be written there.
en.mineLayerDisabled: This layer is disabled and contributes nothing to any assembly right now.
en.mineLayerDisabledFix: Fix: delete the unresolvable {{...}} reference in that layer's config (or turn variable substitution off), then reopen this page. The plugin never rewrites your file.
en.mineLayerDisabledFixGeneric: Fix: repair or remove that layer's config file (invalid JSON, an invalid field and a deleted file all land here), then reopen this page. The plugin never rewrites your file.
en.mineModeBottomNote: The user layer is the lowest one: "Stack" here means the same as "Cover" — there is nothing below it to stack onto.
en.mineModeDirty: The mode changed and is not saved yet.
en.mineModeHintAppend: Stack: this layer's text follows the other layer's, so both apply.
en.mineModeHintReplace: Cover: only this layer's text applies; a same-named entry in the other layer does not.
en.mineModeNote: The mode acts on the one reserved section: the user layer's text first, the workspace layer's after it — one blank line between them when both carry text, none when only one does.
en.mineModeStoredNone: this layer states no mode (read as "Cover")
en.mineNote: What you write here becomes one extra prompt section, placed after every built-in section, effective from the next turn (next-turn). DSH never interpolates it; with variable substitution on, this plugin expands its {{...}} during assembly, and a reference that is unregistered, misspelled or currently valueless stays literal instead of failing the assembly.
en.mineResetBody: This deletes the text stored in that layer and returns it to unconfigured.
en.mineResetTitle: Restore default: delete the {layer} My Prompt
en.mineSaveBlockedDraftElsewhere: Save blocked: you have unsaved text in "{scope}" ({chars} characters) and it is not what the editor is showing. Go back to that scope to save or discard it, then save here.
en.mineSaved: Saved to {layer}; effective from the next turn (next-turn).
en.mineSavedFrozen: Saved to {layer}, but the selected session is frozen, so it will not take effect.
en.mineSavedUnknown: Saved to {layer}; the selected session’s frozen state is unknown, so it may not take effect.
en.mineUnconfigured: Not configured yet: this layer has no My Prompt, so the text is empty.
en.mineWarningUndefined: These variables had no value in the probe that was run, so the save was accepted (a value belongs to the session, not to the text); in a turn that has no value for them, they stay literal instead of being substituted: {list}
en.mineWorkspaceNeedsSession: The workspace layer needs a session; without one it cannot be written.
en.originDownstreamHint: Another plugin added this section after the waterfall. It is not our override and not an anomaly.
en.originUnmatchedHint: This override had no target section to act on.
en.overviewReservedNote: The My Prompt section is not repeated here: it belongs to the My Prompt tab, where it is read and written.
en.overviewScopeDegraded: The workspace service is unavailable; the scope degraded to picking a session.
en.overviewScopeNone: No session is available to scope by yet: open a session on the left, or have the host list workspaces and sessions.
en.ovFixHint: Fix: undo this override and save it again as replace, or use append with a new, unregistered name.
en.ovMergedNote: Merge order: a workspace override wins over the same-name user entry and keeps its position.
en.presetAlreadyAppliedNotice: This preset is already in force in that workspace; nothing was stacked twice.
en.presetAppliedNotice: The preset was applied to that workspace; it takes effect on the next assembly.
en.presetApplyToNote: The version stored in the preset library is what gets applied; unsaved changes in the editor dialog are not.
en.presetDeleteConfirmApplied: This preset is applied to {count} workspace(s); confirming cancels those applications — each workspace is restored to what it held before — and deletes the preset.
en.presetDeleteConfirmBody: The library will no longer hold it.
en.presetDeletedRestoredNotice: The preset was deleted; {count} workspace(s) were restored (their applications cancelled).
en.presetDialogDirtyHint: There are unsaved changes: closing discards them.
en.presetDiscardConfirmBody: This preset’s changes are not saved yet; confirming closes the dialog and writes nothing to the library.
en.presetSaveAsCurrent: Save current text as a preset
en.presetSaveAsCurrentHint: “Save current text as a preset” only fills the editor above with the text "My Prompt" is showing; it writes nothing by itself.
en.presetsEmpty: No presets yet. Create one below, or save the text "My Prompt" currently shows as a preset.
en.presetsLibraryError: The preset library file cannot be read
en.presetsNote: Keep a named text as a preset and apply it to one workspace: applying writes that workspace layer’s reserved section, cancelling restores exactly what was there before.
en.presetTextPlaceholder: This text is written into the reserved section prompt-setting:custom-prompt
en.presetUnappliedNotice: The application was cancelled: that workspace is back to what it held before.
en.presetWorkspaceEmpty: This profile exposes no workspace session, so no preset can be applied.
en.presetWorkspaceNote: Pick a workspace (located by one of its sessions) and apply the preset being edited to it; an existing application can be cancelled here too.
en.promptBlockNote: This scope decides which layer My Prompt is written to — and it is changed here.
en.resetDoneNotice: Restored the default: {count} override(s) removed, effective next turn (next-turn).
en.resetLayerBody: This clears all {count} overrides of the {layer}, effective from the next assembly; the removed content goes to history.
en.resetLayerEmpty: The {layer} holds no override, so there is nothing to reset.
en.resetLegacyBody: This deletes the {count} frozen override(s) of the {layer} (everything except My Prompt) and keeps My Prompt itself.
en.resetLegacyEmpty: The {layer} has no frozen overrides to clear; My Prompt is kept.
en.resetLegacyTitle: Clear every legacy override of the {layer}
en.savedNotice: Saved to {layer}; effective from the next turn (next-turn).
en.savedNoticeFrozen: Saved to {layer}, but the selected session is frozen; it will not take effect here.
en.savedNoticeUnknown: Saved to {layer}; the selected session’s frozen state is unknown, so it may not take effect here.
en.scopeArchivedHidden: {n} archived sessions are hidden (matching the sidebar default); use search, or type an id to view one.
en.scopeCut: {n} more rows exceed the render cap; narrow the range with search.
en.scopeDegraded: This profile provides no useWorkspaces (workspace service unavailable); the picker degraded to a flat session list and cannot group by workspace.
en.scopeGroupsTruncated: Too many workspace groups; only part of them is shown: narrow the range with search.
en.scopeSearchHint: Grouped by workspace, exactly like the left sidebar; a search keeps the owning workspace group of every match, and a workspace-name match keeps all of its sessions.
en.scopeSummaryManual: Session service unavailable: type an id
en.scopeTruncated: Render cap reached (at most {n} session rows at a time): narrow the range with search, or fold other workspaces first.
en.sessionEmpty: The session list is empty; enter a session id or use Global.
en.sessionGlobalNote: No session: the snapshot describes the global assembly and the workspace layer stays inactive.
en.sessionKeyboardHint: Up/Down to move, Enter to select, Esc to clear the search
en.sessionLimit: This profile provides no useSessions (session service unavailable); the picker degraded to a manual session id and cannot list sessions.
en.sessionNoMatch: No session matches; you can view the typed id directly.
en.sessionSelectedNote: Session selected: the snapshot probes that session’s own scope.
en.stBuildPingFailedHint: The ping request failed, so there is no host fingerprint and this tab cannot be judged.
en.stBuildStaleHint: The client.js this tab is running is not the build the host is serving byte for byte: an older tab kept an older bundle. Open a new tab (or reopen Settings in one); a client change needs no host restart.
en.stBuildUnknownHint: The host reported no client.js fingerprint (older host, unreadable file, or missing/duplicated markers), so this tab cannot be judged — it is not treated as stale.
en.stFrozenUnknown: The selected session’s frozen state is unknown
en.stFrozenUnknownNotFrozen: That is not the same as "not frozen"; you can still edit and save, it is just not guaranteed to take effect.
en.stFrozenUnknownProbe: This session’s own assembly cannot be probed.
en.stUnfrozenGlobal: The global assembly is not frozen
en.stUnfrozenSession: The selected session is not frozen
en.subtitle: Inspect and override the system prompt assembled into every session. A write applies to the next assembly (next-turn).
en.title: Prompt settings
en.transferNote: Export produces JSON carrying a schema and a version; an import is previewed with a dry run first, and only a confirmed import writes — staged to a temp file, validated, then renamed atomically.
en.truncated: Long text: showing the first {n} lines only.
en.unresolvedLiteralInline: Also {list}, in sections that are not interpolated: the real prompt carries them as literal braces.
en.unresolvedLiteralNote: These references sit in sections the Host never interpolates (interpolate: false; My Prompt always is one), so they reach the model exactly as written whether or not this plugin's own expansion resolved them — the braces in this preview are the real prompt.
en.unresolvedLiteralTitle: The real prompt is exactly these literal braces
en.unresolvedNote: These references sit in sections that DO interpolate, so the Host throws on every turn while assembling this session's prompt: the prompt cannot be built, and this text is not the real prompt.
en.updateApplyAlready: v{version} is already installed — restart DSH to put it to work.
en.updateApplyAlreadyCli: v{version} is already installed — restart dsh web to put it to work.
en.updateApplyAlreadyDesktop: v{version} is already installed — quit and reopen DeepSeek Harness to put it to work.
en.updateApplyApplied: v{version} is installed and already in effect.
en.updateApplyBody: The host will install v{latest} through the official plugin manager (fetched from the npm registry or a GitHub release artifact, whichever your download region selects; into this profile, with no automatic restart).
en.updateApplyCancelled: The install was cancelled; the profile files were restored.
en.updateApplyDone: v{version} is installed — restart DSH to put it to work.
en.updateApplyDoneCli: v{version} is installed — restart dsh web to put it to work.
en.updateApplyDoneDesktop: v{version} is installed — quit and reopen DeepSeek Harness to put it to work.
en.updateApplyManual: You can also update by hand: {hint}
en.updateApplyManualLink: Open the {tag} release or package page
en.updateApplyRestartNote: You will need to restart DSH yourself for the new version to take effect.
en.updateApplyRestartNoteCli: You will need to restart dsh web yourself for the new version to take effect.
en.updateApplyRestartNoteDesktop: You will need to quit and reopen DeepSeek Harness yourself for the new version to take effect.
en.updateApplyUnknown: This install can no longer be looked up (it may have finished, or this page may have been reloaded). Restart DSH, or use "Check now" to confirm the version.
en.updateApplyUnknownCli: This install can no longer be looked up (it may have finished, or this page may have been reloaded). Restart dsh web, or use "Check now" to confirm the version.
en.updateApplyUnknownDesktop: This install can no longer be looked up (it may have finished, or this page may have been reloaded). Quit and reopen DeepSeek Harness, or use "Check now" to confirm the version.
en.updateRegionAuto: Chosen automatically (the source serves this package): {region}.
en.updateRegionCustomBody: Enter the base address of an npm registry (http(s)://, a path is allowed). The host validates the format and fetches the package document once: an unreachable address, or one that is not an npm registry, is never saved and the source in force stays as it is.
en.updateRegionCustomNote: Use the mirror address you type (validated before it is saved).
en.updateRegionDefaultNote: npm first; GitHub release artifacts only when npm cannot answer.
en.updateRegionSaved: Download region is now {region}; checks and installs use the new source.
en.updateRegionUnusable: The saved custom mirror address is unusable: {reason}
en.updateSettingNote: When the settings page opens, the host checks once for the latest version: it asks the npm registry first and falls back to GitHub Releases only when npm cannot answer — one GET, carrying no local or session data, from whichever source the download region selects (Mainland China = npmmirror). With this off, no update request is made at all, including on page load; turning it on also reads the download-region state once.
en.updateUnknown: Upstream has no usable version information right now.
